OUR HISTORY & DEVELOPMENT

Group experience, expertise focused on cleaning.

Saniteks Sünger Sanayi Turizm ve Ticaret A.Ş. is one of the companies of the Sanifoam group, founded in İstanbul in 1990. Sanifoam produces foam, non-woven and related products for customers in the automotive, white goods, industrial insulation and cleaning sectors.

Besides its own brand, Saniteks produces dish, bath and car sponges under the STAR and Blues brands, and offers a wide range of cleaning products for household and industrial use, including microfibre cleaning cloths, scouring pads and steel scouring balls.

At our production facility in Hendek we produce cleaning sponges, cleaning cloths, scouring materials and special-shape sponges as well as the roll and sheet raw materials used in these products. We assess product and pack options together according to your needs.

OUR APPROACH TO PRODUCTION

We assess the process as a whole.

We approach product decisions by considering the relationship between intended use, material structure and production steps.

  1. 01

    Quality-focused production

    Carefully assessing the product's fitness for its intended use throughout the process.

  2. 02

    Technology and process management

    Managing materials and production steps in a consistent and orderly way.

  3. 03

    Responsiveness to needs

    Listening to expectations, understanding the conditions of use and shaping the right solution together.

  4. 04

    Continuous development

    Learning from experience and looking for areas of improvement in products and processes.

PRODUCTION NETWORK

From management to production, at two sites.

Our head office is in İstanbul and our production is at our facility in Hendek, Sakarya. We are part of the Sanifoam group's infrastructure in Türkiye and Europe.

MISSION AND VISION

Our mission and vision.

Our Mission

Our Vision

An open view of changing needs.

Responsibility
